Following the incident, the Department of Justice's Division of Criminal. criminal investigation conducted an investigation into the officer-involved shooting that resulted in the death of Timothy Burgess. Forensic analysis revealed that eight officers fired a total of over 80 bullets while Timothy Burgess fired at least twice. According to news reports, the autopsy determined that Burgess sustained 11 gunshot wounds. No officers or civilians were injured during the incident. Investigators analyzed data from Timothy's phone, which suggested he may have been seeking a shootout. to the investigative report, the last text he sent, likely to his daughter, read, I love you, I'm sorry, I can't go back to jail, baby. In news interviews, Timothy's sister alluded that the woman heard yelling in the background during the altercation was their mother. Timothy allegedly helped his mother move to that area recently. He may have been trying to reach her apartment when he attempted to flee. Timothy's sister can be quoted saying, I was at work. After interviewing all officers involved, as well as civilians and residents in the area, and analyzing forensic evidence, the investigation concluded, it was determined that no criminal charges would be filed against law enforcement, and no charges appear to have been filed against any other individuals involved in the incident.

criminal investigation conducted an investigation into the officer-involved shooting that resulted

Forensic analysis revealed that eight officers fired a total of over 80 bullets while Timothy
Burgess fired at least twice.
According to news reports, the autopsy determined that Burgess sustained 11 gunshot wounds.
No officers or civilians were injured during the incident.

a shootout.

Interviews summarized in the 700-page investigative report reveal officers' thoughts
during the incident.
A common sentiment among them was fear for the team closest to Timothy when he began firing.
The report notes that one officer physically teared up while recalling the situation, stating,
I thought they had been killed.
After interviewing all officers involved, as well as civilians and residents in the area,
and analyzing forensic evidence, the investigation concluded, it was determined that no criminal
charges would be filed against law enforcement, and no charges appear to have been filed against
any other individuals involved in the incident.

legal.disposition: Suspect deceased; no charges filed against officers.

event_summary.short: After a domestic violence incident with shots fired, suspect Timothy Burgess fled, was located hours later, led police on a foot pursuit, and was fatally shot in a wooded area after firing at officers.
